d:
[Branded Content] Pune is more than one city.
There’s the old city, with its narrow lanes, historic buildings, food and rituals. Then there’s the rapidly growing side of Pune, where IT parks, traffic and a faster pace of life shape the city. And beyond that are the green outskirts, winding roads and landscapes that existed long before the city expanded.
In this film, we explore all three worlds on the BGauss C12 MaxR, moving from the oldest parts of Pune to its modern urban side and then out towards the green edges of the city.
